 let applied=0;
 function apply(img,m){
   if(!img||!m||!PORTRAITS[m.id])return;
   const key=String(m.id)+'-'+(m.shiny?'s':'n');
   if(img.dataset.v3566Photo===key)return;
   img.dataset.v3566Photo=key;
   img.onerror=null;
   img.src=PORTRAITS[m.id][m.shiny?'shiny':'normal'];
   img.style.imageRendering='pixelated';img.style.objectFit='contain';
   applied++;
 }
 function setupSearch(){
   const modal=document.querySelector('#modal'),list=modal?.querySelector('.v331MoveList');
   const heading=modal?.querySelector('.sectionhead h2')?.textContent||'';
   if(!list||!heading.includes('Mewtwo')||!save.team.concat(save.box||[]).some(m=>m?.v3566MewtwoTest))return;
   if(modal.querySelector('#v3566FindMove'))return;
   const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='v3566Search';
   box.innerHTML='<input id="v3566FindMove" type="search" placeholder="🔎 Buscar golpe por nome ou tipo..." autocomplete="off" aria-label="Buscar golpes do Mewtwo"><small id="v3566FindCount"></small>';
   list.insertAdjacentElement('beforebegin',box);
   const input=box.querySelector('input'),note=box.querySelector('small');
   function filter(){
     const query=input.value.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().trim();
     let count=0;
     for(const row of list.querySelectorAll('.v331Choice')){
       const label=row.textContent.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase();
       const show=label.includes(query);row.style.display=show?'':'none';if(show)count++;
     }
     note.textContent=count+' golpe(s)';
   }
   input.addEventListener('input',filter);filter();
 }
 function update(){
   setupSearch();
   document.querySelectorAll('.moncard').forEach((c,i)=>apply(c.querySelector('img.sprite'),save.team[i]));
   const all=[...(save.team||[]),...(save.box||[])];
   document.querySelectorAll('[data-team]').forEach(el=>{
     const i=Number(el.dataset.team);if(Number.isInteger(i))apply(el.querySelector('img.sprite'),all[i]);
   });
   document.querySelectorAll('[data-v331-pokemon]').forEach(el=>{
     const i=Number(el.dataset.v331Pokemon);if(Number.isInteger(i))apply(el.querySelector('img.sprite'),all[i]);
   });
   document.querySelectorAll('[data-swap]').forEach(el=>{
     const i=Number(el.dataset.swap);if(Number.isInteger(i))apply(el.querySelector('img.sprite'),save.team[i]);
   });
 }
 render=function(){const x=previousRender.apply(this,arguments);update();return x;};
 showTeam=function(){const x=previousTeam.apply(this,arguments);update();return x;};

 document.head.appendChild(style);

(function(){
 'use strict';
 const MAX_GRASS_ENCOUNTERS=5;

 const clamp=(n,a=0,b=1)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,n));
 const lerp=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;
 const ease=t=>t<.5?2*t*t:1-Math.pow(-2*t+2,2)/2;
 const ballCount=()=>Math.max(0,(save.balls||0)+(save.superBalls||0)+(save.ultraBalls||0));
 const grassKey=()=>`${save.gym}-${save.stage}`;
 const grassUsed=()=>((save.routeUsed||{})[grassKey()]||0);
 const canExploreGrass=()=>save.gym<8&&save.stage>=0&&save.stage<=v29TrainerCount(save.gym)&&grassUsed()<MAX_GRASS_ENCOUNTERS&&ballCount()>0;

 function refreshGrassUi(){
   const grassBtn=$('grassBtn');
   if(!grassBtn||save.gym>=8)return;
   const used=grassUsed(), remaining=Math.max(0,MAX_GRASS_ENCOUNTERS-used);
   grassBtn.disabled=!canExploreGrass();
   grassBtn.textContent='🔴 EXPLORAR';
   const grassCard=grassBtn.closest('.grass');
   const grassText=grassCard?.querySelector('.grassText span');
   if(grassText){
     grassText.textContent=canExploreGrass()||used>0
       ? `151 Pokémon de Kanto distribuídos por regiões, incluindo encontros raros. ${remaining} encontro(s) disponível(is) nesta parada.`
       : 'Grama disponível desde o início da rota. Tenha Pokébolas para explorar.';
   }
   if(grassCard){
     grassCard.style.cursor='pointer';
     grassCard.onclick=(ev)=>{if(ev.target?.closest('button, a, input, select, textarea'))return; if(canExploreGrass())grassEncounter();};
   }
 }

 const previousGrassEncounter=grassEncounter;
 grassEncounter=function(){
   if(save.gym>=8||ballCount()<=0)return;
   const key=grassKey(),used=save.routeUsed[key]||0;
   if(save.stage<0||save.stage>v29TrainerCount(save.gym)||used>=MAX_GRASS_ENCOUNTERS)return;
   save.routeUsed[key]=used+1;
   const gym=GYMS[save.gym];
   const id=(typeof v27ChooseWild==='function'?v27ChooseWild(save.gym):((gym.wild||[])[Math.floor(Math.random()*Math.max(1,(gym.wild||[]).length))]||16));
   const level=clamp(gym.min-2+Math.floor(Math.random()*4),3,gym.levelCap-2);

 if(typeof v27ShowOdds==='function'){

Você tem ${Math.max(0,MAX_GRASS_ENCOUNTERS-used)} encontros nesta parada.</p><div class="v27OddsList">${options.map((o,i)=>`<div class="v27Odds"><span class="v27OddsNo">#${String(o.id).padStart(3,'0')}</span>${img(o.id)}<span class="v27OddsName">${o.name}</span><div class="v27OddsRail"><i style="width:${Math.min(100,o.pct*7)}%"></i></div><strong>${o.pct.toFixed(2).replace('.',',')}%</strong></div>`).join('')}</div><button class="btn ${can?'gold':'ghost'} wide" id="v27CatchFromOdds" ${can?'':'disabled'} style="margin-top:13px">🔴 PROCURAR POKÉMON</button>`);
     $('v27CloseOdds').onclick=close;
     $('v27CatchFromOdds').onclick=()=>{if(!can)return;close();grassEncounter();};
   };
 }

 const previousRender=render;
 render=function(){
   const out=previousRender.apply(this,arguments);
   refreshGrassUi();
   return out;
 };

 function path(ctx,pts,color,width,alpha=1,blur=0){
   if(!pts||pts.length<2)return;
   ctx.save();
   ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;
   ctx.strokeStyle=color;
   ctx.lineWidth=width;
   ctx.lineCap='round';
   ctx.lineJoin='round';
   if(blur){ctx.shadowColor=color;ctx.shadowBlur=blur;}
   ctx.beginPath();
   ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);
   for(const p of pts.slice(1))ctx.lineTo(p[0],p[1]);
   ctx.stroke();
   ctx.restore();
 }
   
 function dot(ctx,x,y,r,color,alpha=1,blur=0){
   ctx.save();
   ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;
   ctx.fillStyle=color;
   if(blur){ctx.shadowColor=color;ctx.shadowBlur=blur;}
   ctx.beginPath();
   ctx.arc(x,y,Math.max(.4,r),0,Math.PI*2);
   ctx.fill();
   ctx.restore();
 }
 function ring(ctx,x,y,r,color,width=2,alpha=.7,ratio=.72,blur=0){
   ctx.save();
   ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;
   ctx.strokeStyle=color;
   ctx.lineWidth=width;
   if(blur){ctx.shadowColor=color;ctx.shadowBlur=blur;}
   ctx.beginPath();
   ctx.ellipse(x,y,r,r*ratio,0,0,Math.PI*2);
   ctx.stroke();
   ctx.restore();
 }
 function flame(ctx,x,y,rad,rot,alpha=1,core='#fff5bf',mid='#ffb34a',edge='#e94a23',shadow='#ff8a36'){
   ctx.save();
   ctx.translate(x,y);
   ctx.rotate(rot);
   ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;
   ctx.shadowColor=shadow;
   ctx.shadowBlur=8;
   const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(0,0,1,0,0,rad*1.9);
   g.addColorStop(0,core);
   g.addColorStop(.38,mid);
   g.addColorStop(.72,edge);
   g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
   ctx.fillStyle=g;
   ctx.beginPath();
   ctx.moveTo(-rad*.58,rad*.58);
   ctx.bezierCurveTo(-rad*1.04,-rad*.08,-rad*.22,-rad*.55,0,-rad*1.9);
   ctx.bezierCurveTo(rad*.38,-rad*.36,rad*1.06,-rad*.04,rad*.62,rad*.78);
   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0,rad*.96,-rad*.58,rad*.58);
   ctx.fill();
   ctx.restore();
 }
 function waveRibbon(ctx,pts,a,b,width,alpha=1){
   if(pts.length<2)return;
   path(ctx,pts,a,width,alpha,6);
   path(ctx,pts,b,Math.max(1,width*.36),alpha*.96,4);
 }
 function jaw(ctx,x,y,size,open,upper,alpha=1){
   ctx.save();
   ctx.translate(x,y);
   ctx.scale(upper?1:1,upper?1:-1);
   ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;
   ctx.shadowColor='#b871ff';
   ctx.shadowBlur=7;
   ctx.fillStyle='#31104d';
   ctx.strokeStyle='#d7a8ff';
   ctx.lineWidth=1.2;
   ctx.beginPath();
   ctx.moveTo(-size*.9,0);
   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-size*.2,-size*.95,size*.68,-open*size*.4);
   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(size*.28,-size*.06,-size*.15,size*.36);
   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-size*.42,size*.18,-size*.9,0);
   ctx.fill();
   ctx.stroke();
   for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
     const tx=-size*.46+i*size*.24;
     ctx.beginPath();
     ctx.moveTo(tx,0);
     ctx.lineTo(tx+size*.10,-size*.22-open*size*.18);
     ctx.lineTo(tx+size*.18,0);
     ctx.fillStyle='#f7e7ff';
     ctx.fill();
   }
   ctx.restore();
 }
 function splash(ctx,x,y,base,alpha=1){
   for(let i=0;i<11;i++){
     const a=i*(Math.PI*2/11),r=base*(.45+(i%4)*.16);
     dot(ctx,x+Math.cos(a)*r,y+Math.sin(a)*r*.65,2.6+(i%3),i%2?'#effdff':'#89ddff',alpha*(.65-i*.03),4);
   }
 }
 
 const previousPainter=window.PokemonTorreV360Paint;
 const specialMoves3567=new Set(['mordida','labaredafinal','tsunami','soprododragao']);
 const spriteBite3567={};
 for(const [part,url] of Object.entries({"top":"data:image/png;base64,","bottom":"data:image/png;base64,"})){
   const pic=new Image();pic.src=url;spriteBite3567[part]=pic;
 }
 window.PokemonTorreV360Paint=function(ctx,fx,now,e){
   const moveName=norm((fx?.move&&fx.move.name)||fx?.name||'');
   // V35.67 FIX: only intercept the 4 requested moves, BEFORE legacy paint hook.
   // All 25 approved animations are delegated to the original chain, unchanged.
   if(!specialMoves3567.has(moveName))return previousPainter?previousPainter(ctx,fx,now,e):false;
   const t=clamp((now-fx.at)/(fx.duration||1)),fade=clamp(Math.min(t*9,(1-t)*8,1));
   const [ax,ay]=fx.from||[0,0], [bx,by]=fx.to||[0,0];
   const dx=bx-ax, dy=by-ay, dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1, ux=dx/dist, uy=dy/dist, nx=-uy, ny=ux;
   const travel=ease(clamp(t/.8));
   const x=lerp(ax,bx,travel), y=lerp(ay,by,travel);
   const small=e?.fps>0&&e.fps<30;
 
   if(moveName==='mordida'){
     const p=ease(clamp((t-.08)/.68));
     const ix=lerp(ax,bx,p), iy=lerp(ay,by,p);
     for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
       const q=i/6;
       dot(ctx,lerp(ax,ix,q)+nx*Math.sin(q*11+t*18)*3.6,lerp(ay,iy,q)+ny*Math.cos(q*9+t*14)*2.8,2.5+(i%2),'#7b44bd',fade*(.20+.08*i),4);
     }
     const bite=t>.38?clamp((t-.38)/.26):0;
     const size=(small?12:15)+bite*8;
     const targetX=t<.4?ix:bx, targetY=t<.4?iy:by;
     const crunchTop=spriteBite3567.top,crunchBottom=spriteBite3567.bottom;
     if(crunchTop?.complete&&crunchTop.naturalWidth&&crunchBottom?.complete&&crunchBottom.naturalWidth){
       ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=fade*.96;ctx.translate(targetX,targetY);
       ctx.rotate(Math.atan2(dy,dx)*.12);
       const spriteW=size*3.1,spriteH=size*.88;
       const sep=size*(.54-bite*.47);
       ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
       ctx.drawImage(crunchTop,-spriteW/2,-spriteH-sep,spriteW,spriteH);
       ctx.drawImage(crunchBottom,-spriteW/2,sep,spriteW,spriteH);
       ctx.restore();
     }else{
       jaw(ctx,targetX,targetY-size*.08,size,1-bite,true,fade*.95);
       jaw(ctx,targetX,targetY+size*.08,size,1-bite,false,fade*.95);
     }
     if(t>.46){
       const snap=clamp((t-.46)/.40);
       ring(ctx,bx,by,12+snap*24,'#c89cff',2.3,fade*.55,.62,5);
       ring(ctx,bx,by,7+snap*10,'#fff0ff',1.6,fade*.55,.62,4);
       for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
         const a=-.9+i*.36;
         path(ctx,[[bx+Math.cos(a)*6,by+Math.sin(a)*6],[bx+Math.cos(a)*(18+snap*10),by+Math.sin(a)*(16+snap*7)]],i%2?'#fbefff':'#8a51d1',1.8,fade*.72,3);
       }
     }
     return true;
   }
 
 
  if(moveName==='labaredafinal'){
     const rot=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
     const beamEnd=clamp(t/.64);
     const tipX=lerp(ax,bx,beamEnd), tipY=lerp(ay,by,beamEnd);
     const spine=[];
     const pieces=small?18:28;
     for(let i=0;i<=pieces;i++){
       const q=(i/pieces)*beamEnd;
       const swell=.30+.92*q;
       const sway=Math.sin(q*10-now*.010)*7*swell;
       spine.push([lerp(ax,bx,q)+nx*sway, lerp(ay,by,q)+ny*sway*.42]);
     }
     path(ctx,spine,'#ff7b2a',10,fade*.22,10);
     path(ctx,spine,'#ffb247',6,fade*.34,8);
     path(ctx,spine,'#fff1b2',2.8,fade*.60,4);
     for(let i=0;i<pieces;i++){
       const q=(i/(pieces-1))*beamEnd;
       const swell=.36+.88*q;
       const px=lerp(ax,bx,q)+nx*Math.sin(i*1.27+t*11)*8*swell;
       const py=lerp(ay,by,q)+ny*Math.sin(i*1.10+t*13)*4*swell;
       flame(ctx,px,py,4.8+(i%4)*1.5+q*4.4,rot-.32+Math.sin(i+t*9)*.17,fade*(.28+.72*q),'#fff7ca','#ffca5c','#ff7e26','#ff8e2d');
       if(i%3===0) dot(ctx,px-nx*2,py-ny*2,2.3+(i%2),'#ffe9ad',fade*(.10+.35*q),4);
     }
     if(t>.46){
       const boom=clamp((t-.46)/.54);
       const rad=(small?18:26)+boom*24;
       e.shake=Math.max(e.shake||0,6+boom*12);
       ctx.save();
       ctx.globalAlpha=fade*(.30+.30*boom);
       const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(bx,by,2,bx,by,rad*1.2);
       g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,251,214,0.95)');
       g.addColorStop(.28,'rgba(255,207,101,0.90)');
       g.addColorStop(.62,'rgba(255,118,34,0.58)');
       g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,77,18,0)');
       ctx.fillStyle=g;
       ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(bx,by,rad*1.12,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
       ctx.restore();
       ring(ctx,bx,by,rad*.95,'#ffd56d',2.6,fade*.48,.86,6);
       ring(ctx,bx,by,rad*.60,'#fff4c7',1.8,fade*.36,.82,4);
       for(let j=0;j<16;j++){
         const a=j*(Math.PI*2/16)-Math.PI/2+Math.sin(j+t*10)*.08;
         const rr=rad*(.32+.42*((j%3)+1)/3);
         flame(ctx,bx+Math.cos(a)*rr*.55,by+Math.sin(a)*rr*.42,5+(j%4)*1.2+boom*2.8,a,fade*(.55-j*.018),'#fff8cb',j%2?'#ffc967':'#ffb14d','#ff7025','#ff8f31');
         path(ctx,[[bx,by],[bx+Math.cos(a)*rr,by+Math.sin(a)*rr*.74]],j%2?'#ffbf54':'#ff8a32',2.2,fade*.38,4);
       }
       for(let k=0;k<14;k++){
         const a=k*(Math.PI*2/14)+now*.006;
         const rr=8+boom*(16+(k%3)*8);
         dot(ctx,bx+Math.cos(a)*rr,by+Math.sin(a)*rr*.72,2.1+(k%3),'#ffe2a2',fade*(.34-k*.017),4);
       }
     }
     return true;
   }
 
 
  if(moveName==='tsunami'){
     const front=clamp(t/.78);
     const reach=lerp(ax,bx,front), reachY=lerp(ay,by,front);
     const width=small?52:72;
     const height=small?20:28;
     const layers=small?3:4;
     for(let l=layers-1;l>=0;l--){
       const crest=[];
       const base=[];
       const offset=l*(small?6:8);
       const amp=height+l*4;
       const arch=16+l*5;
       const wob=1.1+l*.35;
       const npts=18;
       for(let i=0;i<=npts;i++){
         const q=(i/npts)*front;
         const xx=lerp(ax,bx,q);
         const yy=lerp(ay,by,q)+Math.sin(q*8-now*.012*wob+l)*amp*.42 - Math.sin(Math.PI*q)*arch - offset;
         crest.push([xx,yy]);
         base.push([xx,yy+width-offset*0.4]);
       }
       ctx.save();
       const grad=ctx.createLinearGradient(ax,ay-width*.05,bx,by+width);
       grad.addColorStop(0,l%2?'rgba(105,219,255,0.18)':'rgba(74,186,255,0.16)');
       grad.addColorStop(.45,l%2?'rgba(74,194,255,0.42)':'rgba(40,156,238,0.34)');
       grad.addColorStop(1,l%2?'rgba(222,251,255,0.12)':'rgba(222,251,255,0.10)');
       ctx.globalAlpha=fade*(.38+.12*l);
       ctx.fillStyle=grad;
       ctx.beginPath();
       ctx.moveTo(crest[0][0],crest[0][1]);
       for(const p of crest.slice(1))ctx.lineTo(p[0],p[1]);
       for(const p of base.reverse())ctx.lineTo(p[0],p[1]);
       ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
       ctx.restore();
       path(ctx,crest,l===0?'#9fe8ff':'#4bc1ff',l===0?7:5,fade*(.28+.14*l),8-l);
       const foam=[];
       for(let i=0;i<crest.length;i++){
         const p=crest[i];
         foam.push([p[0],p[1]-4-Math.sin(i+t*10+l)*2.5]);
       }
       path(ctx,foam,'#effdff',l===0?3.4:2.2,fade*(.24+.1*l),4);
     }

mage/png;base64,","data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAABoAAAAMCAYAAAB8xa1IAAAAm0lEQVR42r2SuxGEMAxEVwyFXKiQkDIIKYEyVIZLuJAyCAkVUoYzX3CjGw1z/Md+iSP7aa2lGGPCDhqW76mKPnSEE0griZsGzAweXgCACoU4FNlEzJxXVCyR39Ed7H6WRDIJ6Tz/htOwoDLj3jQATjduS1b7B23xa/mdb1tXvN5K4CVX0/yDAOA9jMlX2BI8FfhUlLvWJiuCtJI+PBBNF5d9br0AAAAASUVORK5CYII=","data:image/png;base64,","data:image/png;base64,","data:image/png;base64,","data:image/png;base64,","data:image/png;base64,"]};
const IMAGES={};
for(const [family,urls] of Object.entries(SPRITE_URLS)){
 IMAGES[family]=urls.map(uri=>{const image=new Image();image.src=uri;return image;});
}
const norm=name=>String(name||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');
const clamp=(x,a=0,b=1)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x));
const lerp=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t;
const ease=t=>t<.5?2*t*t:1-Math.pow(-2*t+2,2)/2;
const TAU=Math.PI*2;
const PAL={normal:['#ffeda8','#c7d9e2'],fire:['#ffac42','#fff1ab'],water:['#2ab5ff','#cbf6ff'],grass:['#67dd70','#d3ffa1'],electric:['#ffe462','#fff9c9'],ice:['#a9efff','#f7ffff'],ground:['#b78b56','#fff0c1'],rock:['#99816d','#ebddc3'],poison:['#b06ae3','#f3c8ff'],ghost:['#8c5ec8','#e7c2ff'],psychic:['#db79db','#ffdbf7'],dragon:['#9a71ef','#edc7ff'],dark:['#634998','#c3adff'],fighting:['#d78563','#ffedd4'],flying:['#a4d5eb','#f7fcff'],steel:['#9fb6c5','#f4ffff'],bug:['#a6d56a','#f2ffb4'],fairy:['#e89ed0','#fff1fa']};
const PREV=window.PokemonTorreV360Paint;
const STATS={casts:0,frames:0,animatedSprites:0,canvasMoves:0,statusPaints:0,lockedPassThrough:0,latest4PassThrough:0,trackedMoves:{},failedSprites:0};
const CURRENT_FOUR=new Set(['mordida','labaredafinal','tsunami','soprododragao']);
const colors=(type)=>PAL[type]||PAL.normal;
function line(ctx,pts,col,width,alpha=1,glow=0){
 if(!pts.length)return;
 ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.lineWidth=width;
 if(glow){ctx.shadowBlur=glow;ctx.shadowColor=col;}
 ctx.beginPath();pts.forEach((p,i)=>i?ctx.lineTo(p[0],p[1]):ctx.moveTo(p[0],p[1]));ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
}
function disc(ctx,x,y,r,col,alpha=1,glow=0){
 ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.fillStyle=col;
 if(glow){ctx.shadowBlur=glow;ctx.shadowColor=col;}
 ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,Math.max(.3,r),0,TAU);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();
}
function ring(ctx,x,y,r,col,alpha=.5,width=2){
 ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.lineWidth=width;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,r,r*.70,0,0,TAU);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
}
function polygon(ctx,x,y,r,ang,n,color,alpha=.85){
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(ang);ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.fillStyle=color;
 ctx.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<n;i++){let a=i*TAU/n,rr=r*(i%2?.72:1);i===0?ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(a)*rr,Math.sin(a)*rr):ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a)*rr,Math.sin(a)*rr);}ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.restore();
}
function leaf(ctx,x,y,rad,ang,col,alpha){
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(ang);ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.strokeStyle='#246642';ctx.lineWidth=.8;
 ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-rad,0);ctx.bezierCurveTo(-rad*.3,-rad,rad*.45,-rad,rad,0);ctx.bezierCurveTo(rad*.4,rad,-rad*.4,rad,-rad,0);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
}
function spark(ctx,x,y,r,col,t,alpha=1){
 for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const a=i*Math.PI/2+t*3;line(ctx,[[x+Math.cos(a)*r*.3,y+Math.sin(a)*r*.3],[x+Math.cos(a)*r,y+Math.sin(a)*r]],col,1.8,alpha);}
}
function sprite(ctx,family,step,x,y,w,h,rotation,alpha){
 const arr=IMAGES[family];if(!arr?.length)return false;
 // Vários quadros alternados, movimento real (trajeto, rotação e tamanho). Não exibe imagem única estática.
 const item=arr[(Math.floor(step)%arr.length+arr.length)%arr.length];
 if(!item?.complete||!item.naturalWidth)return false;
 ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(rotation);ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
 const aspect=item.naturalWidth/item.naturalHeight;
 const bw=Math.min(w,h*aspect*1.5),bh=Math.min(h,w/aspect*1.5);
 ctx.drawImage(item,-bw/2,-bh/2,bw,bh);ctx.restore();STATS.animatedSprites++;return true;
}
function familyFor(type){return ['fire','rock','poison','ghost','dark'].includes(type)?type:null;}
function moveProfile(fx){
 const name=norm(fx?.move?.name||fx?.name||''); const typ=fx?.move?.type||fx?.type||'normal';
 const kind=fx?.move?.kind||fx?.moveKind||fx?.kind||'bolt';
 const cfg=CONFIG[`${name}|${typ}|${kind}`]||CONFIG[`${name}|${typ}`];
 return {name,type:typ,kind,cfg,locked:LOCKED.has(name),latest:CURRENT_FOUR.has(name)};
}
function paint(ctx,fx,now,engine,profile){
 const start=fx.at||now,dur=Math.max(1,fx.duration||fx.end-start||680),t=clamp((now-start)/dur);
 const fade=clamp(Math.min(t*10,(1-t)*9,1));
 const [ax,ay]=fx.from||[0,0],[bx,by]=fx.to||[0,0];
 const vx=bx-ax,vy=by-ay,dist=Math.hypot(vx,vy)||1,nx=-vy/dist,ny=vx/dist;
 const [primary,bright]=colors(profile.type);
 const visual=profile.cfg?.visual||{};
 const scale=clamp(Number(visual.scale)||1,.55,1.7);
 const track=clamp(Number(visual.trail_factor)||1,.55,1.65);
 const frameMs=Math.max(45,Math.min(130,Number(visual.frame_ms)||75));
 const kind=profile.kind;
 const phase=ease(clamp((t-.03)/.76));
 const xx=lerp(ax,bx,phase),yy=lerp(ay,by,phase);
 const family=familyFor(profile.type);
 const seed=profile.name.length*11.5+(profile.name.charCodeAt(0)||0);
 const heavy=kind==='area'||kind==='quake'||kind==='hazard';
 const contact=['dash','contact','physical'].includes(kind);
 const burst=clamp((t-.52)/.48);
 const small=engine?.fps>0&&engine.fps<27;
 const parts=Math.max(4,Math.round((small?7:14)*track));
 if(['recover','shield','status','illusion','guard'].includes(kind)){
   const cx=ax,cy=ay,rad=14+t*33;
   for(let j=0;j<9;j++){
     const a=j*TAU/9+t*5+seed,px=cx+Math.cos(a)*rad,py=cy+Math.sin(a)*rad*.75;
     if(profile.type==='grass')leaf(ctx,px,py,4.4,a,primary,fade*.77);
     else if(profile.type==='electric')spark(ctx,px,py,4.5,bright,t,fade*.7);
     else polygon(ctx,px,py,3.5,a,5,j%2?primary:bright,fade*.82);
   }
   ring(ctx,cx,cy,13+t*29,primary,fade*.44,1.8);
   STATS.statusPaints++;return;
 }
 if(contact){
   // Ataque corpo a corpo: nada de feixe de longa distância; cortes aparecem no local do impacto.
   const q=clamp((t-.28)/.65);
   if(q>0){
     for(let j=0;j<3;j++){
       const angle=Math.atan2(vy,vx)+Math.PI/2+(j-1)*.4;
       const off=(j-1)*10;
       const cx=bx+nx*off,cy=by+ny*off;
       const pts=[];for(let i=0;i<=10;i++){const z=i/10;pts.push([cx+Math.cos(angle)*((z-.5)*31),cy+Math.sin(angle)*((z-.5)*31)+Math.sin(Math.PI*z+q*5)*5]);}
       line(ctx,pts,j%2?primary:bright,3-j*.55,fade*(.8-j*.12),4);
     }
     ring(ctx,bx,by,10+q*29,bright,fade*.55,2.3);
     for(let j=0;j<7;j++){
       const a=j*TAU/7+seed,rr=7+q*24;
       polygon(ctx,bx+Math.cos(a)*rr,by+Math.sin(a)*rr*.75,2+j%2,a,4,primary,fade*.7);
     }
   }return;
 }
 if(heavy){
   const R=(14+phase*34)*scale;
   for(let j=0;j<(small?12:21);j++){
     const a=j*2.399+seed*.08,rad=(j%4)*5+R*.42+burst*14;
     const cx=bx+Math.cos(a)*rad,cy=by+Math.sin(a)*rad*.63;
     if(family){if(!sprite(ctx,family,(now-start)/85+j*.7,cx,cy,17+j%3*3,17+j%3*3,t*5+a,fade*.76))polygon(ctx,cx,cy,5,a,5,primary,fade*.5);}
     else if(profile.type==='grass')leaf(ctx,cx,cy,5+j%3,a,primary,fade*.73);
     else if(profile.type==='water')ring(ctx,cx,cy,5+j%3,bright,fade*.55,2);
     else if(profile.type==='electric')spark(ctx,cx,cy,3.8,bright,t,fade*.82);
     else polygon(ctx,cx,cy,5,a,profile.type==='ice'?6:5,j%3?primary:bright,fade*.7);
   }
   for(let n=0;n<3;n++)ring(ctx,bx,by,R*(.57+n*.24),n%2?bright:primary,fade*(.35-n*.07),2);
   if(profile.type==='fire'&&t>.5)engine.shake=Math.max(engine.shake||0,1.2); // leve, não mexe em golpes protegidos.
   return;
 }
 // Projétil/raio/homing: sequência de quadros oriundos das sheets, partículas em deslocamento e impacto.
 const beam=['beam','pierce'].includes(kind);
 const trail=beam?Math.max(6,Math.round((small?12:22)*track)):parts;
 const pts=[];
 for(let j=0;j<=14;j++){
   const q=(j/14)*phase;
   pts.push([lerp(ax,bx,q)+nx*Math.sin(q*14+t*21+seed)*5,lerp(ay,by,q)+ny*Math.cos(q*14+t*18+seed)*4]);
 }
 if(beam){line(ctx,pts,primary,profile.type==='water'?9:6,fade*.40,7);line(ctx,pts,bright,2.2,fade*.83,4);}
 else if(profile.type==='water'||profile.type==='dragon'||profile.type==='electric')line(ctx,pts,primary,2.2,fade*.38,5);
 for(let j=0;j<trail;j++){
   const q=clamp((j/(trail-1))*phase);
   const wobble=Math.sin(j*1.29+now*.014+seed)*(5+7*q);
   const cx=lerp(ax,bx,q)+nx*wobble*.75,cy=lerp(ay,by,q)+ny*wobble*.5;
   const size=(4+(j%4)*1.25)*scale,alpha=fade*(.27+.65*q);
   if(family&&!(j%2)){
     if(!sprite(ctx,family,(now-start)/frameMs+j*.31,cx,cy,size*3.6,size*3.2,Math.atan2(vy,vx)*.25+t*2+j*.27,alpha)){
        STATS.failedSprites++;polygon(ctx,cx,cy,size,j+t*3,5,primary,alpha);
     }
   }else if(profile.type==='water'){
     disc(ctx,cx,cy,size*1.15,primary,alpha,5);disc(ctx,cx+1,cy-1,size*.58,bright,alpha*.85);
   }else if(profile.type==='grass'){
     leaf(ctx,cx,cy,size*1.3,Math.atan2(vy,vx)+Math.sin(t*12+j)*.6,primary,alpha);
   }else if(profile.type==='electric'){
     spark(ctx,cx,cy,size,bright,t+j,alpha);
   }else if(profile.type==='flying'){
     line(ctx,[[cx-size*1.4,cy+size*.6],[cx,cy-size],[cx+size*1.5,cy-size*.25]],bright,1.8,alpha);
   }else if(profile.type==='psychic'||profile.type==='fairy'){
     ring(ctx,cx,cy,size*1.1,j%2?bright:primary,alpha*.62,1.8);
   }else if(profile.type==='ice'){
     polygon(ctx,cx,cy,size*1.35,t*5+j,6,bright,alpha);
   }else if(profile.type==='steel'){
     polygon(ctx,cx,cy,size*1.3,t*5+j,4,j%2?primary:bright,alpha);
   }else if(profile.type==='bug'){
     line(ctx,[[cx-size,cy-size],[cx+size,cy+size]],primary,2.6,alpha);line(ctx,[[cx+size,cy-size],[cx-size,cy+size]],bright,1.4,alpha);
   }else{
     polygon(ctx,cx,cy,size,t*3+j*.4,5,j%3?primary:bright,alpha);
   }
 }
 if(t>.37){
   ring(ctx,bx,by,9+burst*24,bright,fade*.6,2);
   for(let j=0;j<8;j++){
     const a=j*TAU/8+seed,rad=9+burst*(12+j%3*4);
     if(profile.type==='grass')leaf(ctx,bx+Math.cos(a)*rad,by+Math.sin(a)*rad*.65,4,a,primary,fade*.63);
     else disc(ctx,bx+Math.cos(a)*rad,by+Math.sin(a)*rad*.7,2.7+j%2,j%2?primary:bright,fade*.65,3);
   }
 }
}
window.PokemonTorreV360Paint=function(ctx,fx,now,engine){
 const p=moveProfile(fx);
 if(p.locked){STATS.lockedPassThrough++;return PREV?PREV(ctx,fx,now,engine):false;}
 if(p.latest){STATS.latest4PassThrough++;return PREV?PREV(ctx,fx,now,engine):false;}
 if(!fx?.move?.name)return PREV?PREV(ctx,fx,now,engine):false;
 try{paint(ctx,fx,now,engine,p);STATS.frames++;STATS.canvasMoves++;STATS.trackedMoves[p.name]=(STATS.trackedMoves[p.name]||0)+1;return true;}
 catch(error){console.warn('[V35.68] Não foi possível animar '+p.name,error);return PREV?PREV(ctx,fx,now,engine):false;}
};
// Efeitos de condições/status não seguem a mesma fila de golpes de dano, portanto possuem uma fila independente.
const PREV_USE=BattleEngine.prototype.useMove;
BattleEngine.prototype.useMove=function(slot){
 const b=battle,m=b?.active?current():null,move=m?skillSet(m)?.[slot]:null;
 const name=norm(move?.name||'');
 if(!move||!b?.active||LOCKED.has(name)||CURRENT_FOUR.has(name))return PREV_USE.apply(this,arguments);
 const before=b.energy,cd=cooldowns[slot]||0,now=performance.now();
 const result=PREV_USE.apply(this,arguments);
 const accepted=(b.energy<before)||(cooldowns[slot]||0)>cd;
 if(accepted){STATS.casts++;if(move.kind==='status'||move.cat==='status'||['recover','shield','guard','illusion'].includes(move.kind)){
    this.v3568StatusFX||=[];this.v3568StatusFX.push({at:now,duration:720,from:[this.player.x,this.player.y-this.h*.12],to:[this.player.x,this.player.y-this.h*.12],move:{...move}});
    this.v3568StatusFX=this.v3568StatusFX.slice(-10);
 }}
 return result;
};
const PREV_DRAW=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){
 const res=PREV_DRAW.call(this,now);
 if(!battle?.active||!this.ctx)return res;
 const effects=this.v3568StatusFX||[];
 if(effects.length){this.ctx.save();for(const fx of effects){if(now<=fx.at+fx.duration){try{paint(this.ctx,fx,now,this,moveProfile(fx));}catch(ex){console.warn('[V35.68] efeito de status',ex);}}}this.ctx.restore();this.v3568StatusFX=effects.filter(fx=>now<fx.at+fx.duration);}
 return res;
};
// Mantém os sprites aprovados intocados e atualiza apenas identificação da versão.
const oldRender=render,oldRenderBattle=renderBattle;
function showVersion(){
 const el=document.querySelector('.brand strong');if(el)el.textContent='POKÉMON TORRE · V35.69';
 const tag=document.getElementById('v30VersionTag');if(tag)tag.textContent='V35.69 · 3 GOLPES MELHORADOS';
 const home=document.getElementById('v3520VersionHome');if(home)home.textContent='V35.69';
 document.title='Pokémon Torre V35.69 · 3 Golpes Melhorados';
}
render=function(){const r=oldRender.apply(this,arguments);showVersion();return r;};
renderBattle=function(){const r=oldRenderBattle.apply(this,arguments);showVersion();return r;};
window.PokemonTorreV3568Diagnostics=()=>({version:'35.68',catalogMoves:Object.keys(CONFIG).length,protectedNames:[...LOCKED],...STATS,loadedSprites:Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(IMAGES).map(([k,v])=>[k,v.filter(img=>img.complete&&img.naturalWidth>0).length]))});
showVersion();
